passages.context: All seven body paragraphs were read. The homily develops Luke 17:11-19 as a three-stage journey of faith--crying out, walking together in trusting obedience, and returning to Jesus in praise and thanksgiving--and connects Eucharistic thanksgiving with care for those who have ceased walking.
passages.notes: The HTML does not print paragraph numbers. The locator counts the seven body paragraphs from the first paragraph after the heading. No comparison with the Italian version is claimed.
